_readme: Fill legalName and address before going live. If 34 Automation is a limited company, also fill companyNumber (and registeredIn if not England and Wales). Leave companyNumber empty if it isn't a company. The production build refuses to deploy while legalName or address is empty.
_reviews: reviewsSummary: true shows the review count and the average score above published reviews (only when there is at least one). false hides both. Published reviews live in public/reviews.json.
